_note: Eight consumables. Product ids are fixed on Apple and their numbers are historical: the amount each one grants is in lib/data/purchases.dart (StoreProducts.grants) and functions/verify-purchase/src/main.js (GRANTS); test/economy_test.dart checks that the three agree. Prices are USD; the script picks the matching App Store price point and equalises it across territories. Display name <= 30, description <= 45. reviewScreenshot is the App Review screenshot (a PNG path, optional): the top-level one is the default (the top of the store, for the coins), a product's own replaces it (the store scrolled to Tickets and Boosters for the ticket and booster products).

products.name: 2,500 coins
products.reviewNote: Consumable. Adds 2,500 coins to the player's balance once our Appwrite Function has verified the signed transaction (Production, falling back to Sandbox for sandbox transactions such as App Review's). Coins buy puzzle packs, past monthly packs, avatars and boosters. The product id is historical; the amount is 2,500.
